name: Commerce
summary: A small shop selling mugs, notebooks and prints: a Next.js storefront and admin, a Hono API on Postgres, and Stripe Checkout, Resend receipts and S3 pictures.
runsOn: A Next.js storefront and a Hono API in Chromium, with Postgres in Docker
shows: A whole stack behind one proxy: Stripe Checkout and its webhooks, Resend receipts and S3 pictures, all emulated
Invariants that read the shop's database against Stripe and Resend: one order per payment, stock taken once, one receipt per order
`danwo matrix` faulting Stripe, Resend, S3, the webhooks and Postgres itself (86 trials), and the shop surviving every one
`COMMERCE_BUG` switches that turn one safeguard off, so you can watch the matrix catch it
